title: Hackathon demo: operator assistant over the kanban stream
description: Charter deliverable 3 (CHARTER.md). Operator console + assistant that reads the engine observation stream (station cards, SPC samples, alarms), detects drifting stations early, explains root cause, recommends actions. Measured A/B vs blind baseline: time-to-detection, downtime %, defect escapes. Maps to the Intelligent Industry rubric (real problem, working product, operator-understandable results, measurable improvement).
acceptance_criteria: Demo runs a full episode showing an alert→explanation→recommendation cycle with quantified improvement vs blind baseline

title: Engine: factory simulation core (design doc → API freeze → implementation)
description: Charter deliverable 1 (CHARTER.md). Design-iteration loop first: mechanics spec + RNG inventory, per-mechanic variance/sensitivity prototypes, anti-tape acceptance test, then freeze episode API v1 and build: floor grid + stations + material flow, degradation/quality, kanban partial observability, labour roster, shared market + league runner, kaggle_environments-compatible episode runner. HARD CONSTRAINT: no compute-heavy runs on dawn — runner and league harness must be portable to fleet hosts (dusk/albion) from day one.
acceptance_criteria: DESIGN.md with RNG inventory reviewed; anti-tape + skill-dominance tests pass; seed-determinism + golden-state tests green; league runner executes on a non-dawn host

comments.author: dawn
comments.text: Design-loop step 2 done (layout mechanic, measured): built simulator/proto_layout.py (pure-stdlib, stateless CLI, ~0.6ms/episode) + research/layout_variance_analysis.py. Sweeps ran on dusk (2x 1200 paired episodes, <1s each). Findings (research/2026-10-13-layout-variance.md): layout explains 53-64% of cycle-time variance, scenario 24-32%, noise ~12-15% — skill-dominated anti-tape profile; distant-layout verdicts need 1-9 paired episodes (budget 200). Throughput only weakly layout-coupled -> score must weight cycle/WIP; lam hyperprior near saturation. AGV pool CUT from v1 (answered DESIGN §9 question). Runtime gate 4 comfortably met. Determinism rule added: never seed Random with str/tuple hash (PYTHONHASHSEED salting) — sha256->int via gen_seed(). DESIGN.md updated (§6 findings + §9). Next: mechanic-2 prototype (degradation/kanban SPC drift detection vs sample budget), then anti-tape acceptance test.

comments.author: dawn
comments.text: Charter updated to v2 per alex's direction: (1) goal reframed — engine built as the basis for a Kaggle-style challenge + sample agent tunable with RL (SB3 / knob-search first), demo is the application on top. (2) Explicit anti-tape design goal: less deterministic than kaggriculture (stochastic dynamics per seed, kanban partial observability, no canonical opponent set), with a measurable acceptance test — tape agent must lose to a mediocre reactive agent, and skill must still dominate noise. (3) Design-iteration phase added before API freeze: design doc + RNG inventory, per-mechanic variance/sensitivity measurement, then freeze. Awaiting sign-off.
